sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops quality reports, interaction logging, view tracking, ad measurement, and Firebase Analytics.
Renames the app on the home screen, so it is easy to tell apart.
Keeps the picture-in-picture window at the video's shape, so it does not flicker between sizes.
Signs in with Google through GmsCore instead of Google Play services.
Hides the "Add to membership" shelf on the home screen and in search results.
Hides the rating dialog, promo banners, the app tour, and the "Watch on YouTube" dialog.
Covers and mutes the ads YouTube TV inserts into live breaks, but not the commercials built into the broadcast.
Turns off the ads in on-demand videos and DVR recordings, and overlay and pause ads.
Starts recordings and on-demand videos at high quality instead of stepping up from a low one.
